item.description:
FocusTimer can now be reached without the menu bar.

New

  • A window with the same controls as the menu — opened from Spotlight when there is no room left for the icon in the menu bar
  • While that window is open FocusTimer appears in the dock. Pin it there once and the app is always one click away
  • Clicking the menu bar icon closes the window again

Improved

  • When an update has been downloaded, the menu offers "Restart to Update" — it used to wait unnoticed for the app to be quit some day
  • The readme explains why the icon disappears from a crowded menu bar, and the two things that fix it
